task.title: Bound supervisor task-state lock latency and projection truth

scope.owned_layer: Authoritative task-state snapshot and transaction cost; supervisor runtime-admission boundaries around provider/network/projection/archive/termination work; governed status-command derived views; real command/full-cycle evidence.
scope.not_changing: No production config, task ownership, provider routing, dispatch priority, event schema, hash-chain fields, nonterminal-drop policy, product service, or hosted deployment.

incident.root_cause: Repeated full journal replay/validation plus network, archive, projection, and termination waits reachable from exclusive runtime/task critical sections.

acceptance.statement: No runtime-admission or task-state lock is held across provider/network subprocesses or poll sleeps.
acceptance.delivered: Provider probes, GitHub bus, worker-base fetch, ownerless merged-PR lookup, task-state projection reconciliation, auto-archive subprocess work, and termination confirmation execute outside exclusive runtime admission. Auto-archive and PR snapshots have freshness gates.

acceptance.statement: Authoritative reconciliation uses one stable journal generation without duplicate full replay.
acceptance.delivered: A validated generation is process-cached only while dev/inode/size/mtime-ns/ctime-ns remain exact. Governed mutations hold one journal writer lock and extend one rolling snapshot across durable outbox saves. Forced full replay remains available.

acceptance.statement: Approve, assign, note, and reviewer commands remain below two seconds p95 during full supervisor cycles on a roughly 2000-event / 134 MiB fixture.
caught_up reports post-reconciliation parity and repaired separately reports a write.
Concurrent append and reconciliation preserve sequence, SHA, leases, and task state.
acceptance.delivered: The transaction test proves monotonic sequences and previous-event hashes across multiple saves from one stable head. The full benchmark proves exact final journal/projection SHA after all eight real mutations. Existing lease validation remains active for six worker-bound commands.

acceptance.statement: The regression reproduces the live multi-minute shape and proves governed reviewer/status commands no longer stall.
acceptance.delivered: The same 2050-event fixture reports legacy p95 78.651s and real governed/full-cycle current p95 1.662s. The harness exits nonzero unless p95 is below 2s, all commands succeed, supervisor overlap occurs, and final projection is exact.

acceptance.statement: No live config/manual-kill/task-file mutation; branch, PR checks, independent review, merge, and closeout evidence complete.
acceptance.delivered: No config edit, live worker signal, or manual status/activity/current-work edit. Candidate implementation, benchmark, and owner validation are complete.
acceptance.remaining: Open a fresh PR, pass required checks, receive fresh Codex2 approval, merge, record merge evidence, and perform owner closeout.

properties: PID reuse sends no signal to the replacement process.
SIGTERM/grace/escalation execute after runtime lock release.
Worker remains nonterminal until disappearance is observed.

negative_tests: Edited history invalidates the accelerated generation and raises.
Truncation cannot be served from a stale checkpoint.
Corrupt checkpoint degrades to full replay and repairs itself.
Forced full replay matches accelerated event count, head, state, and SHA.
Short append readback raises instead of accepting partial state.
Stale ownerless PR identity and locked network fallback fail closed.
Stale derived projections cannot overwrite current views.
Missing PID start ticks and reused PIDs receive no signal.

pytest.command: env -u PANTHEON_STATUS_ROOT -u PANTHEON_TASK_STATE_STORE_MODE -u PANTHEON_TASK_STATE_EVENT_LOG PYTHONPATH=.orchestrator .venv-pantheon/bin/python3 -m pytest -q .orchestrator/test_supervisor.py .orchestrator/test_runtime_state.py .orchestrator/rewrite/test_task_state_store.py .orchestrator/rewrite/test_worker_lifecycle.py scripts/test_ai_status.py

benchmark.conclusion: meets_target=true; legacy p95 78.651s; real governed/full-cycle current p95/max 1.662s; 8/8 commands; 10 run_once cycles; exact projection at event 2066

residual_risks.risk: A first read in a new command process still validates the full journal generation.
residual_risks.containment: The formal 134.852 MiB, four-worker benchmark remains below 2s p95. Same-process supervisor phases reuse an exact generation; mutation outbox saves reuse one writer-locked rolling snapshot.

residual_risks.risk: Exclusive status-writer latency grows with simultaneous writers and journal size.
residual_risks.containment: Re-run the committed harness if routine concurrency exceeds four workers or the journal grows materially beyond the measured fixture; consider governed compaction as a separate task.
